frames.model: X fwd, Y up, Z right, metres
frames.fusion: X right, Y fwd, Z up, cm; model (x,y,z) m -> Fusion (z,x,y)*100
frames.stl: STL files are Fusion world cm, Z-up, binary, exactly like stl/ in manifest.json (paths here are relative to inventory/fusion/)

conventions.servo_deg: rotation of the servo arm about +axis (right-hand), 0 = CAD neutral arm angle; arm limits +-45 deg
conventions.surface_deg: rotation of the surface about +axis (right-hand): ailerons/elevator positive = trailing edge down; rudders positive = trailing edge toward +Z model (right)
conventions.ail_L/ail_R: same sign relation: servo +deg -> TE down on both sides (the servo shaft axis in hardware.json is mirrored but the planar geometry is identical)
conventions.rod_angle_deg: rotation of the pushrod line about +axis relative to neutral

sources: inventory/hardware/hardware.json (servo shaft pos HW-067/072/077, hinge_line HW-100, wheel pos HW-053)
four_bar_method: servo arm hole P1 rotates about the shaft S by the servo angle; the horn hole P2 rotates about the hinge H by the surface angle; |P1-P2| = rod length (neutral value); solved by bisection with continuation from neutral (fusion/make_kinematics.py)

groups.name: Aileron_R
groups.contains: surface body + control horn + backing plate + 2 horn screws + 2 nuts
groups.limits_source: mechanisms.json throw_deg at servo +-45 deg: +-26.1 (solver here: 26.11 / -26.15)
groups.positive: rotation about +axis (right-hand): trailing edge down

driver.note: surface_deg = f(servo_deg), table below; the linear motion link in Fusion uses the secant ratio (error up to ~0.8 deg mid-range)

groups.name: Arm_Aileron_R
groups.contains: servo output arm (23T) + arm screw
groups.neutral_arm_angle_basis: angle of (hole - shaft) in the plane normal to axis_m, u = model X, v = axis x u
groups.positive: rotation about +axis (right-hand) = servo angle in this file; TE down on Aileron_R
groups.note: for the surfaces whose servo shaft axis in hardware.json is -Z (aileron_L, elevator) the command sign is the opposite of the angle here; geometry is identical

groups.name: Pushrod_Aileron_R
groups.contains: rod with Z-bend + Kwik-Link clevis + keeper bead

driver.relation: rod pose per servo step: p1 = arm hole, p2 = horn hole (rows below)

groups.transform_rule: M = T(p1_step) * Rot(axis_cm, rod_angle_deg) * T(-p1_neutral)  applied to the neutral STL

groups.name: Wheel_FR
groups.contains: Du-Bro 300SL wheel: tyre + hub (HW-053)
groups.positive: rotation about +X (right) = +Z model, right-hand; rolling forward = positive rotation about -X... sign: positive about +X rolls the top toward the rear? see note
groups.note: positive about +X: the wheel top moves toward -Y (aft) i.e. the aircraft rolls rearward; use negative for forward roll. Wheel OD 76.2 mm: forward distance = angle(rad) * 38.1 mm

groups.name: Wing_Panel_R slide on the joiner
groups.positive: panel moves outboard (+X)
groups.limit_source: joiner insertion 300 mm (Wing_Joiner 8..38 cm from the centre line in the CAD); the brief said ~120 mm, 300 mm fully clears the joiner
groups.note: carries the whole right wing group: spar tube, booms, clamps, mounts, motors, props, gear, ESCs, aileron, rudder, elevator servo and tail stub, H-tail seat

groups.name: Wing_Panel_L slide on the joiner
groups.positive: panel moves outboard (-X)
groups.note: carries the left wing group (incl. pitot, airspeed module)

groups.name: H_Tail lift-off the boom stubs
groups.positive: up (+Z)
groups.limit_source: estimate - the seat height / screw length from J-16 is not turned into a travel in the data (-)
groups.note: jointed to the right stub only so that the joint graph stays a tree (the H-tail spans both stubs)

groups.name: Canopy lift-off
groups.positive: up (+Z)
groups.note: carries canopy screws, GPS mast and GPS

groups.name: Battery along its tray
groups.positive: forward (+Y)
groups.limit_source: Fusion motion-clearance sweep 2026-11-02 (fusion/motion_clearance.md): the pod battery pocket was battery-sized with zero play; pocket extended -5/+8 mm and formers (6.5 mm rear, 9.5 mm front) limit the free travel to -4/+7 mm (was an estimate of +-30 mm)
groups.note: CG trim travel only 11 mm; the battery cannot be lifted out in this CAD (pod ceiling z>-2.0, wing saddle y<0 above it, canopy covers y 10..31 only) - see motion_clearance.md
